sampling.scope: per-environment injected sampling noise only; not a guarantee of identical output actions
sampling.scheme: SHA256(task, environment_seed, action_chunk_index, repeat_index) seeds independent CPU normal noise, then cast to model dtype
sampling.action_repeatability: not bitwise reproducible; cause not established

timing: Recorded process durations summed across selected completed task runs or batches; excludes expert screening and complete scheduling/retry history.
seed_policy: Reuse expert-passed seeds; scenario-specific full-task sets. Scaling shares 128 seeds and saved instructions; N=200 adds 72 seeds.
scope: Report, processed outcome evidence, GPU samples and offline figure regeneration. Simulator adapters and model serving implementation are external.
unavailable: Attribution of throughput gains to individual components
